label: Nonprofit relaunch
note: 36 rows with one real two-step chain. The correct result is a warning to collapse the chain, with nothing else wrong.

label: Bilingual clinic site
note: A header row inside the data, accented and encoded duplicates, wildcard rows and a real loop between /en/careers and /en/jobs. Review the wildcard rows by hand, because they are not real patterns here.

label: Domain move, path to full URL
note: Moving a path to the same path on a new domain is valid. All 9 rules are good and none is a self-reference.

label: Loops hidden by query strings
note: Three redirects loop once the query string is added. Do not deploy this map even if the check shows no loops.

label: Multi-region sites, same path
note: The same path redirects differently on different domains. These 5 rules are fine, not conflicts.

label: Normalisation rows
note: Rows that fix slashes, capitals, http to https and www. These are normal and flagging them as errors is a false alarm.

label: Two rules for /team
note: Two rules send /team to different places. Set trailing slash to "different" and case to "sensitive": a clean report would be wrong because the second rule can never run.

label: Large migration, first 1,500 rows
note: A larger map to see how the tool handles volume. Long result tables may be shortened on screen.

label: Excel export with accents
note: A file saved in the older Windows encoding. If an accented letter shows as a question mark, save it as UTF-8 and try again.
